source.method: Robots-permitted public NCAA.com statistic pages; raw response hashes are retained per page and normalized table cells are preserved.
source.limitation: NCAA.com lower-division tables expose names and team slugs but no athlete IDs; no name-only identity join or D1 substitution is performed.

d2.identity_note: NCAA.com publishes no athlete ID in these tables; rows remain separate and are not joined to ESPN identities.
